title: Krawtchouk Polynomial Radial Hadamard Matrix Law and Quadratic Root Blind Spots
claims: On the K-wire Hamming association scheme H(K, 2), H^{otimes K} acts on the (K+1) weight shells |S_w> via the involutory radial matrix M_{k, w} = 2^{-K/2} sqrt(C(K, w)/C(K, k)) K_k(w; K) satisfying M^2 == I_{K+1}.
The degree-2 Krawtchouk polynomial K_2(w; K) = 0.5*((K - 2w)^2 - K) vanishes at the exact integer weights w_pm = (K +/- sqrt(K))/2 whenever K is a perfect square.
